## Checklist

- [ ] I used fictional or de-identified content only — **no real student or family data, names, phone numbers, or contact details** anywhere in the diff, fixtures, or commit messages
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] I updated documentation if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, `.env`, or new hard-coded credentials
- [ ] I did not weaken the approval gate or the high-risk escalation path
